title: Intrinsic Contraction Theory and Stabilization of Probability Measures on the Wasserstein Space
summary: Deterministic flows can contract Wasserstein distances between probability laws without being contractive in point-state space. We develop a differential contraction theory for pushforward flows on forward-invariant subsets of the 2-Wasserstein space that quotients out the gauge freedom of the continuity equation. Weighted Helmholtz-Hodge decomposition and the Wasserstein contingent cone define the weighted horizontal tangent cone (whtc).
